thread:
incident-bot: Pager: abnormal surge and 5xxs on /v1/embeddings and elevated latencies on /v1/chat.completions. Auto-paging #incidents + oncall. Acknowledge please.

zara_oncall: ack. seeing embeddings error rate spike to ~10% and chat p99 creeping up. Dashboards show a handful of keys sending huge batches. Investigating logs.

leo_ml: early read: two things coincided – a model-optimizer roll that increases cold-start cost + multiple high-concurrency embedding jobs. Result: model swap churn and eviction thrash. Recommend immediate route shaping and a batch-size validator.

tom_sre: agreed. I'll push conservative global per-route limits and enable request shedding for oversized embedding requests. We'll leave enterprise exceptions as preemptible.

zara_oncall: applying mitigations now (internal admin tools). Commands below:
```bash
# global route quotas (temporary emergency)
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/quotas \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_per_minute":12,"burst":24}'

curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/quotas \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat.completions","limit_per_minute":70,"burst":100}'

# block huge batches with 413 and guidance
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/ingress/validators \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_batch_tokens":100000,"error_code":413,"error_msg":"Batch too large. Split into batches <= 100k tokens or use smaller batch_size."}'
```

deploy-bot: emergency-quotas-2167001234 queued. Rolling to edge clusters.

quota-bot: Rule applied to edge cluster ap-south-1: rule-id ql-2167-AP.

tom_sre: pushed envoy rate-limit descriptors (snippet):
```yaml
- match: "/v1/embeddings"
  rate_limit:
    rpm: 12
    burst: 24
    response: 429
- match: "/v1/chat.completions"
  rate_limit:
    rpm: 70
    burst: 100
    response: 429
```
Applied sequentially across regions.

maria_cs: alerting affected customers. Two big tenants admitted they launched nightly reindex jobs. Asking them to pause. Preparing template for temporary exception requests.

leo_ml: to avoid punishing paid users, propose per-key overrides: default=embeddings 12rpm/chat 70rpm, paid=chat 180rpm/embeddings 120rpm, enterprise=negotiated (preemptible). I'll prepare admin payloads.

zara_oncall: adding per-key override for enterprise customer ent-204 (requested via CS):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/v1/keys/ent-204/quotas \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_per_minute":250,"preemptible":true}'
```

quota-bot: per-key override applied in rr-13 regions.

tom_sre: after limits and validator, runtime memory pressure dropped; model swaps decreased. embeddings errors fell from 10% -> 1.7% in patched regions. chat p95 down from ~1.1s to ~360ms.

olga_pm: good quick win. Need to document: 1) per-route surge policy, 2) customer guidance for batch sizes, 3) how CS requests exceptions. Add to postmortem.

maria_cs: created support tickets for customers who asked for exceptions and included ETA + instructions to pause. One customer asked for a temp bump; granted preemptible override.

leo_ml: next: schedule rollback window for optimizer if model swap metrics don't resume healthy levels. Also implement an automated detector for backfill patterns (many large requests from a single key) to trigger soft-shedding earlier. I'll file an action item.

zara_oncall: I'm handing incident lead to tom_sre in ~20m. Handoff note: quotas applied (/v1/embeddings=12rpm, /v1/chat.completions=70rpm), batch validator active (max_batch_tokens=100000 -> 413), rerank left enabled only for paid tiers. Enterprise exceptions applied as preemptible.

tom_sre: ack taking lead. I'll keep monitoring kernel-fallback logs, OOMs, and queue-depth. Plan: keep current limits for 1 hour and then relax gradually if stable.

maria_cs: draft customer message: "We observed elevated latency and errors for embeddings. To protect service stability we temporarily applied per-route throttles and limited oversized batches. If you'd like a short-term exception, reply to your ticket. We're monitoring and will update in 60 minutes."

deploy-bot: emergency-quotas-2167001234 completed in rr-13a, rr-13b, rr-13c.

quota-bot: Edge rules active in 5 regions. Metrics: embeddings errors 1.7%, p95 740ms; chat p95 340ms.

leo_ml: leaving follow-ups: 1) UI for per-key quota management + audit trail, 2) auto-detect large-batch backfills and auto-apply soft shedding, 3) documentation update for recommended embed batch_size and tokens. I'll own items.

zara_oncall: thanks team. Leaving notes in #incidents-handoffs. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 2167001234: mitigations applied. Monitoring window 60 minutes. Please attach quota diffs and edge config to the postmortem ticket once stabilized.

tom_sre: moving to "stabilizing". Ping @tom_sre or escalate to @leo_ml if anything regresses.

maria_cs: will send final customer summaries after 60m.

incident-bot: Pager closed (acknowledged). Reminder: create postmortem and include exact admin API payloads, per-key exception list, and env snapshot.
